function.name: get_balance
function.description: Read-only: return current integer balance, credit limit, and frozen status for a member from the latest ledger checkpoint export.

function.name: get_member_history
function.description: Read-only: return recent signed transactions involving a member (as sender or recipient) from the append-only log via checkpoint.

function.name: list_freezes
function.description: Read-only: list members currently frozen by governance events.

function.name: submit_issuance
function.description: Propose a signed governance issuance event. Does not apply directly; produces a payload that must be signed by an authorized admin and submitted via the ledger API. Echo never holds signing keys.

amount.description: Positive integer amount in BIC units

reason.description: Short justification for the issuance (e.g., community service)

function.name: broadcast_mesh_text
function.description: Queue an outbound plain-text message for delivery over the Meshtastic mesh channel. Mesh is a delivery channel only; does not affect the ledger.

target.description: Optional: 'all' or a specific node ID / member ID for directed message

function.name: query_weather
function.description: Fetch current or short-term weather for Beaver Island (or specified location) to inform community messages or med-reminders. External call; not ledger-related.
